milestones.title: Community Trust Inception
milestones.description: The trust was officially registered under the leadership of Sri. Rama Rao Bayanapalli, uniting 50 founding families.

milestones.title: First Community Hall Built
milestones.description: Constructed the Bayanapalli Community Hall to host spiritual, social, and cultural events locally.

milestones.title: Green Township & Wellness Program
milestones.description: Initiated a township-wide tree plantation drive and free monthly health clinics for members.

milestones.title: Educational Scholarship Scheme
milestones.description: Launched an annual scholarship program funding higher education for meritorious children of support staff.

milestones.title: Digital Community Platform
milestones.description: Inaugurated our official community portal to preserve archives, member directories, and event history.
